sentences: Where passenger loading zones are provided, at least one accessible passenger loading zone is required in every continuous 100 linear feet of loading zone or fraction thereof.
Requirements for accessible passenger loading zones address vehicle pull-up spaces and access aisles, including their dimensions, surfacing, and vertical clearance.
On-street bus stops also must comply with requirements in §810.2 to the maximum extent practicable.
Yes, the access aisle at accessible passenger loading zones must be at the same level as the vehicle pull-up space it serves.
State or local codes and regulations may specify such markings.
Vehicle pull-up spaces are not required to be marked.
